fundamentals.name: Reddit, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Reddit, Inc. operates a digital community in the United States and internationally. The company's platform enables user to engage in conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share laughs, and find belonging. It also organizes communities based on specific interests that enable users to engage in conversations by sharing experiences, submitting links, uploading images and videos, and replying to one another. Reddit, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing, highly profitable social media platform with strong margins and a healthy balance sheet.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 79.1% (EPS 1.01 vs 0.56); next earnings date is 2026-07-30.
positives: Revenue growth 69.1% YoY and earnings growth 675.0% YoY indicate strong top- and bottom-line expansion.
Profit margin of 28.6% and gross margin of 91.4% demonstrate exceptional profitability.
Forward P/E of 19.19 is attractive relative to the high growth rates and PEG ratio of 1.21.
Total cash of $2.77B and minimal debt provide significant financial flexibility.
Strong analyst consensus ('buy') and a high mean target price suggest positive future outlook.
negatives: Beta of 1.85 indicates higher volatility compared to the broader market.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 13.19 is on the higher side, though justified by growth.

news.paragraph: Reddit shares surged nearly 17% following strong earnings and new AI data partnerships, building on a prior week that saw an expanded Shopify partnership and a 58.6% one-year surge. The company's impressive revenue and earnings growth, coupled with high margins and a solid balance sheet, have attracted significant analyst attention, with a consensus 'buy' rating and a mean target price well above the current spot. While the stock has seen substantial appreciation, its forward P/E remains reasonable given the growth trajectory and AI data deal potential.
